source.author: verg
source.text: Iuvenes, quae causa subegit ignotas temptare vias, quo tenditis? inquit.
source.text_original: 'Iuvenes, quae causa subegit / ignotas temptare vias, quo tenditis?' inquit.
source.text_english: Young men, what reason has driven you to try unknown roads? Where are you heading? he said.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: scio me cunctis e gentibus unum illicitas temptare vias hiememque mereri:
reuse.text_original: scio me cunctis e gentibus unum / illicitas temptare vias hiememque mereri: /
reuse.text_english: I know that I alone among all peoples try forbidden paths and deserve winter:
